The public medical curriculum evidence identifies technical-English learning, but does not establish that a medical subject is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: UTA’s Faculty of Medicine was created in November 2022. Its predecessor, the School of Medicine, was created in June 2015 and the medical degree began operating in 2016. The faculty is based in Arica, in Chile’s Arica y Parinacota Region.

The faculty has a Department of Clinical Sciences responsible for clinical-area teaching and for research in university teaching. Its Department of Biomedical Sciences covers basic and biomedical training, including molecular/tumour immunology and medical education innovation.

Medical internships use the Hospital Dr. Juan Noé Crevani: UTA reports a five-week placement in its medicine service, alongside ambulatory training at UTA’s medical centre. UTA also records coordination of Medicine internships at Hospital Regional de Iquique.

The Faculty’s Clinical Simulation and Skills Centre was founded in 2018. UTA describes teaching areas for adult, paediatric and obstetric hospitalisation, operating theatre, resuscitation/emergency, skills and debriefing.

For rheumatology, the affiliated Arica regional hospital publicly reports a rheumatology outpatient clinic and a rheumatologist hired in 2025. UTA’s current postgrad list does not list a rheumatology specialty programme, so this is more relevant as a potential clinical-service contact than a training post.
